_comment: Per-leg mutmut survivor-count ratchet. Increases are a real signal (new code shipped without a killer test) and are flagged via ::warning:: in the mutation-tests job. Decreases should be committed here to tighten the ratchet. Every number below is from workflow run 32563… on 2026-08-22, the first run after fourteen test files were wired into the legs whose targets they exercise -- before that, several legs were mutating code while running none of its killer tests. Changes that run made visible: coordinator 66->55 and minor-entities 10->6 purely from the wiring; control-entities 2->4 and sensor-values 1->5 are the residue of the external car-SOC feature (equivalent mutants: falsy-flag assignments, a multi-line log string, an unused default argument, and a module-level block deletion mutmut misreports as survived); diagnostics-triggers is new at 14 (8 pre-existing in device_trigger.py, 6 in diagnostics.py that _SENSITIVE_NAME_RE already backstops, documented at TO_REDACT). sensor-values keeps the get_time_drift <= tolerance boundary plus a pre-existing substate check in sensor_definitions.py, neither from this feature. sensor-values is recorded at its MEASURED 5, not the 3 expected once the CONF_EXTERNAL_SOC_ENTITY storage-key literal added to test_const_soc_modes.py takes effect -- baselines are only ever tightened on an observed decrease, never on a prediction, or the ratchet fires false warnings. Tightened 2026-09-15 from workflow run 34912988899 (rc 678a3ed, all 11 legs completed, no timeouts), decreases only: config-flow 74->58, payload-utils 87->80, coordinator 55->53, minor-entities 6->1, sensor-values 5->2; the other six legs measured exactly at baseline and stay. Remaining survivors in the tightened and unchanged legs are equivalent: type-annotation operator swaps (`X | None` -> `X & None`), falsy-initialiser swaps, an unused default argument, `//` -> `/` inside int() on a positive timestamp, the estimate-hold boundary `stepped < last` -> `<=` (equal values hold the same number), plus the documented device_trigger/TO_REDACT set. Split 2026-09-15: sensor_definitions.py moved to its own sensor-definitions leg (same killer tests) because the shared leg reached 103 of 120 minutes. The two measured sensor-values survivors are split by identity, one per file: sensor_definitions `stepped < last` -> `<=` and ev_sensors `//` -> `/`.
